ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Across formal addresses and case comments, this phrase names an intricately joined and patterned point at which the recorded utterer asks for a reply, denies easy resolution, or appraises detailed handling.
EvidenceBody: Mi'an Xianjie asks where the intricate knot and woven pattern finally lies and follows with two parallel lines about stars and rivers. Miaogao Tuian Daoyan Xun says that even on reaching its place, the ancestral matter remains unsettled. Pinjixiang Zhixiang raises a ceremonial implement and asks what understanding there is of it. Dahui Zonggao says that at this place it cannot be transmitted or explained to another person. Tiantong Hua applies the phrase while commenting on two elders' detailed handling of a case. These are questions, warnings, and appraisals of the same fixed image, not separate referents.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: The ordinary image of a joined knot and woven pattern recurs as the object of public questions, a named point reached in an address, and an appraisal in case commentary.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The corpus does not separately gloss the four graphs or state that the phrase encodes a doctrine. This entry therefore reports only its fixed image and observable deployment.

DifferentThingTest.Reason: Every retained witness applies the same complete image to intricate handling or its difficult point; none identifies a different object, person, title, or institution.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: The aliases reverse or simplify the English syntax while preserving both the knotting and patterning components; they introduce no additional reading.

ModifierControls.Finding: Their independent ordinary uses were excluded; only the complete fixed phrase supports this sense.

FamilyControls.Finding: Nearby flower-clustering and brocade imagery was compared but was not treated as an occurrence of this headword or as a second sense.
